description: BaNaZr₂F₁₁ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal pyramidal geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.42 Å. Ba is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.72-2.85 Å. Zr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.26 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Zr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ba, and one Zr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Zr atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Zr atoms.
